systemPromptSection: pluglet is the user's task list: a JSON file on disk that the user also reads and writes through the `pluglet` CLI, so what you add or complete is visible to them and what they add is visible to you. Use the pluglet_* tools whenever the user asks to record, review, count or finish their tasks, or asks which pluglet commands their profile offers. Pass the same `profile` value on every call in a conversation so every call addresses one task file. Only list, add, done and help are callable here: a task cannot be edited or deleted through these tools, and a command that pluglet_help reports but these tools do not cover is something the user runs themselves.

tools.name: pluglet_list
tools.description: Return every task in id order, one per line as `<id> [x] <title>` for a done task and `<id> [ ] <title>` for an open one. Empty output means the list has no tasks.

profile.description: Path to the pluglet profile file; relative paths resolve from the working directory. Omit it to use `pluglet.profile.json` there.

tools.name: pluglet_add
tools.description: Append a new, not-done task to the task list and return `added <id>: <title>`, where id is the next sequential integer.

profile.description: Path to the pluglet profile file; relative paths resolve from the working directory. Omit it to use `pluglet.profile.json` there.

tools.name: pluglet_done
tools.description: Mark the task with the given id done and return `done <id>: <title>`; a task that is already done returns `already done <id>: <title>` and the list is unchanged. An id that no task has is an error.

id.description: Id of the task to complete, as shown by pluglet_list.

profile.description: Path to the pluglet profile file; relative paths resolve from the working directory. Omit it to use `pluglet.profile.json` there.

tools.name: pluglet_help
tools.description: Return the commands available under the profile, one per line as `<name>  <description>`, including the commands that the profile's plugins add.

profile.description: Path to the pluglet profile file; relative paths resolve from the working directory. Omit it to use `pluglet.profile.json` there.
